title: Evaluating socket management with clot -retaining collagen: A single -blind randomized clinical trial
authors: Mirmohammadsadeghi H, Kadkhodazadeh M, Bakhtiari F, Mighani F, Bakhtiari Z, Dabiri N. J. Dent. Mater. Tech. 2025 Mar. 14. doi: 10.22038/jdmt.2025.80534.1660 * collacone®
supports: Clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The application of Collacone® following atraumatic tooth extraction does not offer any advantages in preserving socket dimensions and reducing patients' pain, comfort, bleeding, and swelling levels in healthy young individuals” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
